# ARIA Role Reference

> Authoritative source: ARIA Authoring Practices Guide (APG) — https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/

## Role reference table

| Role | When to use | Key states / properties | Keyboard behavior | Announcement pattern |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `button` | Triggers an action | `aria-pressed` (toggle), `aria-expanded` (disclosure), `aria-disabled` | Enter, Space | "Button" + label + state |
| `link` | Navigates to a URL or anchor | `aria-current="page"` (nav items) | Enter | "Link" + label |
| `textbox` | Single-line text input | `aria-required`, `aria-invalid`, `aria-describedby` (hint/error) | Standard text entry | Label + "text field" + value + state |
| `combobox` | Input with autocomplete / select | `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls`, `aria-activedescendant` | Arrow keys (list), Enter (select), Escape (close) | "Combobox" + label + value + expanded state |
| `listbox` | Select from a static list | `aria-selected`, `aria-multiselectable` | Arrow keys, Space/Enter (select), Home/End | Option label + "selected / unselected" |
| `checkbox` | Independent toggle | `aria-checked` (true / false / mixed) | Space | "Checkbox" + label + state |
| `radio` | One choice from a group | `aria-checked`; must be inside `radiogroup` | Arrow keys within group | "Radio button" + label + state + position |
| `radiogroup` | Container for radios | `aria-required`, `aria-labelledby` | — | Group label before first item |
| `switch` | On/off setting | `aria-checked` | Space | "Switch" + label + "on / off" |
| `dialog` | Modal requiring interaction | `aria-labelledby`, `aria-describedby`, `aria-modal="true"` | Tab cycles within; Escape closes | "Dialog" + title on open |
| `alertdialog` | Critical modal (blocking) | `aria-labelledby`, `aria-describedby`, `aria-modal="true"` | Tab cycles within; Escape may be suppressed | Immediately announced on open |
| `alert` | Inline status (urgent) | — | — | Immediately announced (assertive) |
| `status` | Inline status (non-urgent) | — | — | Announced politely when idle |
| `tab` | Tab in a tablist | `aria-selected`, `aria-controls` | Arrow keys between tabs | "Tab" + label + position + state |
| `tablist` | Container for tabs | `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby` | — | — |
| `tabpanel` | Content area for a tab | `aria-labelledby` pointing to its tab | — | — |
| `navigation` | Nav landmark | `aria-label` when multiple nav exist | — | "Navigation" + label on region entry |
| `main` | Primary page content | — | — | "Main" on region entry |
| `region` | Named section | `aria-labelledby` (required for landmark) | — | Label + "region" |
| `menu` | Context / action menu | — | Arrow keys, Enter (execute), Escape (close) | "Menu" on open |
| `menuitem` | Item in a menu | `aria-haspopup` (submenu), `aria-disabled` | Enter, Arrow right (submenu) | Label + "menu item" |
| `tooltip` | Supplemental hover/focus info | `aria-describedby` on the trigger element | — | Read as description of the trigger |
| `progressbar` | Task progress | `aria-valuenow`, `aria-valuemin`, `aria-valuemax`, `aria-valuetext` | — | "Progress bar" + label + value |
| `log` | Appending sequential content | `aria-live="polite"`, `aria-relevant="additions"` | — | New items announced as added |
| `grid` | Interactive data table | `aria-rowcount`, `aria-colcount`, cell positions | Arrow keys, Enter (edit), Escape (cancel) | Cell content + position |

## Live region cheat sheet

| Urgency | Role / property | Use for |
|---|---|---|
| Immediate interrupt | `role="alert"` or `aria-live="assertive"` | Errors, critical alerts |
| Polite queue | `aria-live="polite"` | Success messages, status updates, load complete |
| Silent | `aria-live="off"` | Updating content user doesn't need to track |
| Atomic update | `aria-atomic="true"` | Announce full region when any part changes (e.g., timer) |
| Additions only | `aria-relevant="additions"` | Append-only regions (chat, log) |
